title.zh: 将宿务省 Aloguinsan 市镇 Rosario 描笼涯中学改设为独立的 Rosario 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Converting the Rosario Barangay High School in Rosario, Aloguinsan, Cebu, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Rosario National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Rosario Barangay High School in Rosario, Aloguinsan, Cebu, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Rosario National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะ Rosario Barangay High School เป็น Rosario National High School

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7812_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barangay high school of Barangay Rosario in the Municipality of Aloguinsan, Cebu, is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as Rosario National High School.
Upon organization of Rosario National High School, all assets, liabilities, personnel, equipment and records of Rosario Barangay High School shall be transferred to the Rosario National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports is hereby empowered to promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 26, 1994
